hook: *60* runners take water-saving message Nagole to Tarnaka
hook_b: *60* runners take water-saving message Nagole to Tarnaka
tldr: Malkajgiri Municipal Corporation and LB Nagar Runners held a 10 km 'Sweat Run' for water conservation, power saving and the environment.

beats.what: Participants went through Nagole, Uppal and Habsiguda to the MMC headquarters in Tarnaka with banners, per Telangana Today.
beats.why: The event aimed to flag water scarcity and electricity use challenges.
beats.care: East Hyderabad residents may see more conservation drives from the civic body.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Central Ground Water Board was among the event's supporters.

cards.q: What's the easiest way you save water at home?

qs: What concrete steps will MMC take on water saving?

facts.t: *More than 60* runners and cyclists joined the run.

viz.verdict: An awareness event, no new rules announced

watch: Whether MMC follows up with water-saving measures.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Hyderabad: Malkajgiri civic body organises 10-km Sweat Run to promote water and energy conservation

fact: Over *60* runners and cyclists did a 10 km water-saving run to Tarnaka.
twist: Organisers tied the run to future water and power stress from the *El Niño* effect.
